charge_port.notes: electrive/InsideEVs 2025-09-08: Audi EVs lack a NACS port; the e-tron GT is supplied with the Audi NACS DC adapter (CCS1 to NACS). Applied to 2026: same hardware as 2025, no change reported.

supercharger_access.notes: InsideEVs/electrive 2025-09-08: e-tron GT gains Supercharger access (US and Canada same date); new 2025 e-tron GT purchases include the NACS adapter.
